  desc "Manages cron entries for the root user via the crontab command"

  def exists?
    crontab_lines.any? { |line| line.include?(resource[:command]) }
  end

  def create
    lines = crontab_lines
    lines << "#{resource[:minute]} #{resource[:hour]} * * * #{resource[:command]}"
    write_crontab(lines)
  end

  end
